name: PR Brief: a PR with no stored brief offers 'Generate brief' (SPEC-03 AC-83)
description: From the PR list open seeded PR #483 ('Add coupon discount calculation + tests'), which has no stored brief, and confirm the Overview tab shows the 'PR Brief' section (uppercased by CSS, so 'PR BRIEF' for `wait --text`) with a 'Generate brief' button (AC-83). The flow never clicks the button: generating needs a model call, which e2e flows never make, and a generation stored on #483 in a dev DB would break this flow outside e2e:hermetic (e2e/docs/insights.md). Read-only seeded data; no chat. The row click keeps --exact (the next-intl blob in a <script> tag can match a non-exact text locator).
